Reporting to the VP, Operations, this leader will set the quality agenda, lead the Quality organization, and establish the operating discipline, systems, and leadership routines required to deliver consistent customer and operational outcomes. This role requires a proven quality leader who can move beyond compliance to build a scalable quality operating model, elevate accountability across sites, and influence leaders at all levels to adopt new standards, behaviors, and ways of working.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Set and execute the quality strategy, operating model, governance routines, and performance expectations needed to improve quality outcomes across sites
* Lead, coach, and develop Quality Managers and site quality teams to strengthen capability, accountability, decision-making, and execution discipline

* Lead significant customer, product, process, or operational quality issues with clear escalation, root-cause discipline, corrective action, and organizational learning

Elevate is committed to providing the highest quality commercial roofing, wall and lining systems to solve our customers’ challenges, grounded by a 45-year legacy of proven experience. Our mission is to deliver solutions that save time, perform reliably and protect our communities. We are devoted to building partnerships rooted in trust in reflection of our Elevate promise that Nobody Covers You Better™.
  
  
Elevate is part of the Amrize family of brands. Visit ElevateCommercialBP.com to learn more.
  
  
We’re seeking a Director of Quality Assurance who’s ready to be part of a people-first company offering best-in-class products, exceptional training, and deep industry pride—all built to help our partners and team succeed.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Quality Assurance Director strategically leads the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive quality evaluation and control systems across the organization. This includes overseeing the design and analysis of inspection and testing processes, ensuring the precision and accuracy of products and equipment, driving root cause analysis for incidents, and establishing compliance with reliability standards and documentation requirements to uphold the highest levels of product quality and operational excellence
  
  
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Strategic Oversight - Overseeing and directing the overall operations of quality assurance within a company to ensure continuous improvement and compliance. This involves defining and promoting a quality mindset across the entire company.
* Quality Management System - Developing and implementing quality management systems to ensure product and service quality, and maintaining and improving quality standards, policies, and procedures.
* Compliance & Regulatory Oversight - Ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulations, and company policies, and coordinating with regulatory bodies and external auditors.
* Quality Control, Claim Mgmt, Supplier Quality - Overseeing quality control processes to ensure products meet quality standards, and conducting regular quality audits and inspections to identify and address quality issues.This also includes establishing and enforcing quality standards, testing materials and products, and developing raw material and in-process product inspection standards.
* Continuous Improvement - Leading continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency, and implementing best practices to reduce defects and improve processes. This can involve applying tools such as CAPA, SPC charts, Root Cause Analysis, and FMEA, and leading Six Sigma or Lean initiatives.
* Leadership & Team Development - Leading and mentoring the quality assurance team, fostering a culture of high performance and professional development, and ensuring the team has the necessary skills and resources. Responsible for generating a culture of collaboration across the organization.
* Budget & Financial Management - Achieving financial objectives by preparing the quality assurance budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
* Customer Experience - Gathering customer feedback through gemba and data collection on quality andperformance, ensuring products meet or exceed customer expectations, and implementing changes based on feedback
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas.
* Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Mgmt, or related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* At least 8 y+ years of relevant quality, continuous improvement, manufacturing experience including at least 5 years management or direct/indirect leadership experience.
* 3+ years of QMS / ISO9001 or similar experience required.
* CMQ/QE, CQE, CQA are all preferred.
* Six Sigma certification preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators.
* Employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Retirement Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program

protected_roles.description:
**Summit Polymers is a leading, global supplier of automotive interior systems including consoles, door panels, and instrument panels. With over 50 years serving the industry, we deliver engineering and product excellence to our customers, on time, in budget, with the latest innovations.**
JOIN A TEAM WHERE YOU’LL BE CHALLENGED AND valued.
  
  
A career with Summit Polymers means working with smart people in a culture that thrives on challenging, meaningful work. At Summit, we look for growth potential with every hire. We don’t just fill seats, we set people on career paths. We’re always on the lookout for smart people who are committed to continuous improvement, customer service and quality.
  
  
**Job Description**
**JOB TITLE:**
Director, Corporate Quality
**FLSA STATUS:**
Exempt
  
  
**REPORTS TO:**
Regional Director of Manufacturing (Corporate)
  
  
**Summary**
This management position is responsible for developing, implementing and continually improving the company’s standardized manufacturing quality systems globally. The Director, Corporate Quality works collaboratively with plant quality managers, general managers and other company resources to achieve world class quality performance as measured by customer quality scorecards. The Director, Corporate Quality interfaces with key customer personnel to build customer confidence in Summit Polymers, ensure Summit Polymers meets customer expectations and requirements, and to resolve significant customer quality concerns.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Duties**
Is responsible for the following major tasks:
  
  

* Exhibits positive leadership and acts with highest levels of integrity and ethics
* Champions corporate wide manufacturing quality system standardization

+ Leads and collaborates with plant quality managers, general managers and RDMs to determine best practices and develop standardized quality system and procedures applicable to all manufacturing facilities
+ Administers, trains, and communicates the company’s standardized quality system and procedures to ensure they are effectively implemented and maintained throughout the company
+ Performs plant quality system standards compliance audits and leads follow up action plan reviews with each plant
+ Lead continuous improvement of quality systems

* Champions overall quality scorecard performance for all customers

+ Develops deep knowledge of every customer quality scorecard
+ Leads specific customer scorecard training for plant quality managers, materials managers and general managers to ensure these leaders understand scoring methodology and act to ensure scorecard success
+ Monitors customer scorecard methodology and scoring changes, and ensures corporate procedures, metrics and personnel proactively adapt to changes to ensure customer scorecard success
+ Engages with other functional departments to ensure all aspects of customer scorecards are understood and actions are taken to ensure scorecard success (examples Sales – cost reductions, materials – minority sourcing)
+ Assists in developing internal performance metrics that support successful customer scorecard results

* Interfaces with key customer personnel & engages customer quality events

+ Develops constructive relationships with key customer contacts
+ Builds customer’s confidence in SPI’s performance, capabilities, systems, and integrity
+ Represents the company at customer “quality roundtable” events
+ Reviews customer quality system requirements and specifications and ensure they are effectively communicated and implemented at all levels of the organization

* Engages in significant customer quality concerns and warranty issues

+ Participates in problem solving and customer response preparation for significant customer quality issues
+ Represents the company at critical customer quality concern reviews, leading company response and negotiation to achieve successful resolution
+ Acts as point of contact for customer warranty concerns and engages plant and engineering resources to solve warranty concerns

* Provides quality expertise as a corporate resource

+ Champions Practical Problem Solving activities across the company, including improving effectiveness of management team leadership of the process
+ Key leader for development, update, training and compliance to corporate IATF-16949 compliant systems and procedures
+ Supports new business initiatives and projects with data, metrics, support plans, and technical expertise as related to quality
+ Provide support in developing and performing training plans for quality managers and quality engineers at manufacturing plants
+ Provides additional support at manufacturing plants as needed

* Other tasks and duties as assigned

**Education And Experience**

* 4-year college degree in technical or management field preferred
* 5 years’ experience in role of Quality Manager at automotive supplier preferred

**Skills And Abilities**

* Broad knowledge of quality systems and management practices in automotive plastics manufacturing operations
* Expertise in major automotive OEM quality systems; Ford Q1, GM BIQS, FCA, Nissan, VW, BMW, and Toyota
* Expert problem solving skills utilizing root cause based methods; Practical Problem Solving (PPS), 8D, and 5 why methodology
* Must be able to gather and analyze information easily and make appropriate decisions.
* Outstanding leadership, team building, coaching and decision making abilities
* Highly energetic, confident, and assertive with the ability to lead and motivate others
* Must have excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
* A minimum score of 50 on the Wonderlic Select Assessment (Traditional score of 28 on the cognitive portion).

**Travel Requirements**
This position typically does require approximately 18 weeks per year of travel to Summit Polymers Manufacturing Sites.
  
  
**DISCLAIMER**
The information contained in this job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor are they intended to be an all-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Management may, at its discretion, assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Agreement to complete all post-hire required training.

Provide executive leadership for LP's Manufacturing Services organization, setting the strategy, governance, and performance expectations across procurement, environmental, health & safety (EHS), and quality assurance.
  
  
This role ensures strong alignment between service functions and plant operations to enable safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing execution. The Vice President partners closely with Operations leadership and enterprise stakeholders to drive operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across the business.

* Advance sourcing strategies and supplier management to drive value, resilience, and cost competitiveness

What do I need to be successful?

* Progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, operations, or related service functions (EHS, quality, procurement)
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise or multi-site organizations
* Strong track record of driving operational performance, safety, and continuous improvement
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and operating in a matrixed environment
* Ability to translate strategy into execution across diverse teams and geographies
* Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills
* Skill in budget development and management

**Qualifications**

* 15 years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing or operations, including responsibility for large-scale operations, strategic planning, and execution required

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) Business or related field required
* Advanced degree preferred

Work Environment
  
  

* Office Environment
* Extended work hours
* Extensive travel to various locations required

LP offers competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits and programs including health and welfare benefits, 401(k) program, career mobility, tuition reimbursement, volunteer opportunities, profit sharing and more.

protected_roles.description:
Changing lives. Building Careers.
  
  
Joining us is a chance to do important work that creates change and shapes the future of healthcare. Thinking differently is what we do best. To us, change equals opportunity. Every day, our colleagues are challenging what’s possible and making headway to innovate new treatment pathways to advance patient outcomes and set new standards of care.
  
  
**Summary**
The VP, Corporate Quality Systems is a key member of the Quality Leadership Team (QLT) with responsibility to design, implement and oversee the Integra Global quality system, including identifying compliance improvement and remediation strategies across Integra LifeSciences. This role will work cross-functionally across all Integra facilities to build an integrated Quality system infrastructure that supports continued compliance across Integra sites. This role is crucial for ensuring the development, manufacture, and distribution of medical devices in compliance with corporate policies, U.S. Food and Drug Administration regulations, ISO 13485, the Canadian Medical Device Regulations (CMDR), the EU Medical Device Regulation, Japanese Pharmaceutical Affairs Law, and other applicable regulatory agencies.
  
  
**SUPERVISION RECEIVED**
Reports to the Chief Quality Officer.
  
  
**SUPERVISION EXCERCISED**
Directly manages a Quality system corporate team (CAPA, NCE, Doc Control, Management Controls, Training/L&D, Audit/Compliance, Corporate Headquarters Site Quality, and Post Market Surveillance).
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily as follows:
  
  

* Build a high-performance quality culture and team, empowering and holding direct reports and cross-functional teams accountable for successful quality and compliance transformation. Leads with authority and influences globally across manufacturing and distribution facilities and cross functional stakeholders including but not limited to quality, product development, process technology, operations, supply chain, procurement, regulatory affairs, finance, and human resources.
* Develop organizational design and governance to achieve success. Provide strategic direction and communication of the quality transformation goals, creating a clear vision and integration with overall business objectives. Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the effectiveness of quality and compliance remediation. Highlighting trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Leads the design, execution and evolution of the Global Quality System for Integra in conjunction with the Compliance Master Plan (CMP) team, requiring cross-functional collaboration and understanding of various roles within the organization.
* Support interactions with regulatory bodies and ensure compliance with all applicable quality and safety standards. Responsible for leading the team with the review and finalizing any responses to regulatory authorities in collaboration with the Chief Quality Officer.
* Lead the identification, analysis, and resolution of quality issues and non-conformities across various departments in collaboration with the Quality Systems and CAPA teams. Ensure remediation efforts are managed through the QMS.
* Foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement within the organization. Promote the use of lean and Six Sigma methodologies to enhance quality and operational efficiency. Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in quality management and remediation practices.
* Guide the activities required of the quality organization to ensure compliance with all appropriate regulations and standards, including FDA Part 820, ISO 13485, CMDR, MDR, MDSAP, and JPAL. Ensures compliance and readiness globally in collaboration with the QMS.

**Qualifications And Experience Requirements**
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required for this position:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree is required, in engineering, science or closely related technical discipline is preferred. A master’s degree preferred.
* 18+ years of experience leading a team (direct reports or projects) or equivalent education and years of management experience
* Experience in highly regulated industries required, medical device and/or pharmaceutical preferred, including material remediation experience
* Strong analytical skills, exceptional writing and interpersonal relationship skills or a combination of relevant work experience and education.
* Demonstrated knowledge of FDA regulations, ISO 13485, CMDR, Medical Device Directive Regulation (93/42EEC), Japanese Pharmaceutical Affairs Law, and other national and international regulations and standards.
* Experience with direct contact with FDA and EU Notified Bodies.
* Knowledge of process design and implementation, change control, auditing, and document management systems required, general knowledge of statistical analysis preferred.
* Demonstrated organizational, management and communication skills. Proven track record of cross-functional collaboration across teams and change management skills. Strong ability to influence across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Experienced with interacting with Executive leadership to execute decisions and manage risk.
* Ability to travel up to 50% if needed based on site needs. Regular on-site presence in Massachusetts and New Jersey facilities.

**PERSONAL COMPETENCIES**
As a senior leadership position in the company, the role is expected to demonstrate on all Integra Leadership Capabilities.
  
  

* Enterprise Mindset: Leaders with this capability make decisions, set priorities, and share resources based on what will benefit Integra as a whole.
* Thought Leadership: Leaders with this capability build personal credibility and utilize business acumen and customer mindset to influence the innovation and growth of the business. Works with a high level of strategic thinking.
* Drive Performance: Leaders with this capability drive performance and accountability through others and self.
* Enable Talent: Leaders with this capability strive to engage, support, and develop self and others, optimizing the success of individuals and teams and are experienced in dealing with change management.

At CompoSecure, we are redefining the future of payment card technology. As a global leader in premium metal payment cards and fintech solutions, we combine innovation with craftsmanship to deliver exceptional products for the world's leading financial institutions.
  
  
We're looking for talented individuals who share our passion for excellence and innovation.
  
  
**Position Overview**
This role provides senior leadership and ownership of the functions that safeguard product integrity and the operating environment: Quality, Compliance (Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Safety and regulatory conformance), Security, and Facilities. The position is accountable for ensuring that products consistently meet quality specifications, that operations remain fully compliant with regulatory and safety standards, that the site and its products are secure, and that facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment. The role establishes clear metrics and ownership across these areas and reports performance to senior leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality: Establish and maintain quality control protocols for raw materials, components, and finished products. Design inspection and testing processes and provide guidance on maintaining consistent quality from the beginning of production through final release. Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, monitor quality metrics, and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate root causes of defects. Ensure conformance to customer, product, and industry specifications.
* Compliance: Ensure full compliance of operations with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and applicable safety standards in accordance with New Jersey law. Own audits, certifications, and documentation, and serve as the primary liaison with regulatory bodies, auditors, and customers on compliance matters. Identify potential risks and pitfalls (e.g., equipment failures or other disruptions) and develop strategies to mitigate these issues through process improvement, alternative suppliers of materials, or altered equipment.
* Security: Oversee physical and product security programs consistent with the company's trust and authentication mission. Establish and enforce protocols to protect raw materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and sensitive assets throughout the facility and supply chain. Ensure operations meet payment-industry and customer security requirements, and manage security personnel and access controls across all shifts.
* Accountability: Own the key performance indicators and reporting for quality, compliance, security, and facilities. Establish clear ownership, metrics, and dashboards, report performance to senior management, and foster a culture of accountability across the organization. Manage a team of approximately 35 people across 7 shifts supporting QA, Safety & Security.
* Facilities: Oversee facility operations, maintenance, and environmental health and safety of the buildings, grounds, and utilities. Ensure facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment, manage facility vendors and contractors, and lead facility-related capital projects, space planning, and safe-workplace initiatives.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations Management, or a related field.
* A minimum of 10–15 years (or more) of relevant experience in quality, compliance, and/or operations leadership in a high-volume manufacturing environment (Pharmaceutical, Semiconductor, Automotive, or secure/payment products) , with at least 5-10 years experience in managing teams across multiple shift in a 24/7 environment :
* Deep knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 for automotive, AS9100 for aerospace, etc.)
* Six Sigma / Lean methodologies (typically Black Belt or Master Black Belt level)
* Root cause analysis and CAPA (corrective and preventive action) processes
* Statistical process control (SPC) and data-driven decision making
* Supplier quality management and audit experience
* Very strong analytical skill set, including familiarity with quality and reliability tools (e.g., FMEA, SPC, Kaizen).
* Regulatory fluency:
* OSHA, EPA, ISO 14001 (environmental), ISO 45001 (occupational health & safety)
* Industrial hygiene and risk assessment methodologies
* Environmental compliance (emissions, waste management, hazmat handling)
* Process safety management
* Incident investigation and workers' compensation/claims oversight
* Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams required.
* Demonstrated experience in third party audits ( ISO , PCI, ....)
* Occasional travel to suppliers and partners.

**Preferred Skills And Qualifications**

* Quality certifications such as Black belt Six Sigma
* GHG Management
* Familiarity with ERP tools
* Experience in a secure payment, or otherwise highly regulated manufacturing environment.

**About CompoSecure**
CompoSecure, a GPGI business (NYSE: GPGI), is the leading manufacturer of Premium Metal Payment Cards and also offers best-in-class Authentication and Digital Asset solutions. The Company's offerings combine elegance, simplicity, and security to deliver exceptional experiences and peace of mind, enabling trust for millions of people around the globe. For more information, please visit
**www.CompoSecure.com**
and

protected_roles.description:
**Vice President, Global Product Distribution Quality**

**The Opportunity**

Our client is a leading global medical technology company looking to appoint a hands-on VP Global Product Distribution Quality. Reporting directly to the SVP of Corporate Quality, you will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies to effectively manage all global product distribution quality. In this role, you will lead the global product distribution quality organization and processes, holding quality management accountability for all captive and outsourced distribution centres across every entity worldwide.

This is a genuine turnaround and organizational design mandate, rather than a caretaker or step-up role. You will step in to stabilize day-to-day operations, manage significant FDA and global regulatory scrutiny, and reshape the commercial quality infrastructure into a world-class function. For a seasoned executive who enjoys building progressive systems at scale, there is a clear path to expanded enterprise responsibility within 6 to 20 months.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Distribution Governance:**
  Own quality management systems/compliance performance across captive/3PL distribution centres globally - alongside full P&L, budget, and headcount accountability for the function.
* **Turnaround & Future-State Design:**
  Audit current teams, workflows, and systems to close compliance gaps, restructuring the global commercial quality organization into a streamlined, best-in-class model.
* **FDA & Global Regulatory Execution:**
  Act as the single accountable global executive for all distribution-related regulatory inspections, audit responses, and direct agency communications, including intensive FDA engagement.
* **Quality Systems & Digital Traceability:**
  Direct the IT partnership to optimize warehouse management systems (WMS), end-to-end product traceability, inventory controls, and nonconforming product containment.
* **Enterprise Leadership:**
  Serve as the global subject matter expert for distribution quality and contribute to enterprise-wide quality strategy as a senior member of the Global Corporate Quality leadership team.

**Candidate Profile**

* **Sitting or Recent Med-Tech VP:**
  Minimum 10 years of global organizational leadership at the Vice President level within medical devices, capital equipment, or adjacent life sciences—ready to deliver impact from day one.
* **Post-Manufacturing & 3PL Mastery:**
  Deep operational expertise in commercial, supply chain, and global distribution quality across multi-site networks (upstream supplier quality into manufacturing is out of scope).
* **Proven Remediation Track Record:**
  Demonstrated success leading quality turnarounds, organizational redesigns, and systemic remediation under active FDA scrutiny.
* **Global Trade & Customs Compliance:**
  Hands-on command of international medical device regulations, import/export laws, embargoes, import bans, and regional market-entry barriers.
* **Academic Foundation:**
  Bachelor of Science in a medical or applied science discipline

**What Sets You Apart**

You lead from the front with high energy and a clear appetite for complex turnarounds. You combine sharp analytical rigor with executive presence, enabling you to influence across commercial, supply chain, and regulatory stakeholders while building high-performing global teams.

The Global Head of Quality provides strategic leadership and oversight of ProSciento's global Quality department, establishing the strategy, direction, governance, and priorities for the function. This role will oversee the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensures the organization maintains the highest standards of quality, regulatory compliance, and inspection readiness.

  

This role is accountable for establishing and advancing the company's quality strategy, Quality by Design and governance framework, and quality culture while ensuring compliance with applicable GxP regulations, FDA requirements, ISO standards, and other country specific, regional, and international regulatory requirements. The Global Head of Quality partners closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, risk management, and organizational effectiveness while supporting ProSciento's strategic growth. Performs duties in accordance with ProSciento's values, policies, and procedures. Approximately 20% domestic and international travel is expected, with additional travel required based on business needs.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

  
* Provides strategic leadership for ProSciento’s Quality department, establishing the vision, priorities, and organizational structure to support the company’s operations and business objectives.
  
* Accountable for the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations including GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), FDA, ISO, data privacy requirements, and other local, national, and international requirements.
  
* Responsible to oversee the quality of Global CRO studies and local site CRU trials as well as hands on experience implementing and maintaining a strategic Quality by Design framework for both business units.
  
* Responsible for the definition, development, implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of quality systems, processes, and Key Quality indicators (KQIs) to drive operational excellence and regulatory compliance.
  

  

  
* Oversees the Quality Event Management program, including deviations, CAPAs, change control, investigations, risk assessments, and process improvement initiatives. Chairs or delegates the CAPA Board and ensures timely resolution of quality issues.
  
* Directs internal, external, sponsor, vendor, and regulatory inspection readiness activities, including audit planning, execution, response management, and corrective action oversight.
  
* Partners with Vendor Management to oversee supplier qualification, vendor audits, performance monitoring, and quality risk mitigation.
  
* Leads Executive Quality Management Reviews, ensuring quality trends, compliance risks, audit outcomes, CAPAs, and quality metrics are routinely communicated to Executive Leadership with appropriate recommendations and mitigation strategies.
  
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and governance of Quality Management System documentation, including quality policies, SOPs, work instructions, controlled documents, training programs, equipment records, and electronic document management systems.
  
* Partners with Information Technology and business leaders to ensure computerized systems, electronic records, and applicable equipment are appropriately qualified, verified, or validated in accordance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  
* Establishes and promotes a culture of quality throughout the organization by providing strategic guidance, regulatory interpretation, and quality leadership across all functional departments.
  
* Maintains current knowledge of evolving global regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices, ensuring organizational policies and procedures remain compliant and effective.
  
* Builds, develops, and leads a high-performing Quality organization by fostering employee development, succession planning, collaboration, accountability, and a culture aligned with ProSciento's core values.
  
* Serves as the senior quality representative for regulatory agencies, sponsors, auditors, and executive leadership on matters relating to quality systems, compliance, and inspection readiness.
  

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Provides leadership and oversight for the Quality organization, including workforce planning, organizational design, recruitment, employee development, performance management, succession planning, coaching, and employee engagement.
  
* Establishes departmental objectives, allocates resources, and ensures the Quality organization effectively supports ProSciento's strategic and operational priorities.
  

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Qualifications:**

  

To perform this job successfully an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, or Regulatory Compliance within the CRO or clinical research industry, including at least 5 years in senior quality leadership roles with responsibility for organizational quality strategy and personnel management with a minimum of 3 years of Global experience.
  
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience will be considered.
  

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND COMPETENCIES REQUIREMENTS:**

  

**Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:**

  

  
* Extensive knowledge of Quality Management Systems and quality governance, with demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving quality systems within clinical research and regulated environments.
  
* Comprehensive knowledge of applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards, including FDA regulations, ICH Guidelines, GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP), ISO 9001, data integrity, and applicable privacy requirements. Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving Quality Management Systems (QMS) supporting GCP, GLP, GMP (GxP) environments and clinical research operations.
  
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor and internal audits, supplier qualification programs, CAPA governance, inspection readiness, and enterprise quality risk management.
  
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing quality organizations, while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
* Proven strategic leadership, organizational planning, and change management skills, with the ability to partner with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to establish quality strategies and organizational priorities.
  
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and risk assessment capabilities.
  
* Strong communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all organizational levels.
  
* Experience leading regulatory inspections, sponsor interactions, and quality governance forums.
  
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with operational execution in a dynamic, fast-paced organization.
  
* Proficiency with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), document management systems, quality metrics, and computerized system validation principles.
  

  

**Language Skills:**

  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to interpret complex regulations, prepare executive reports, develop policies and procedures, and effectively communicate with regulatory agencies, sponsors, auditors, executive leadership, and employees.

  

**Reasoning Skills:**

  

Ability to analyze complex regulatory and operational issues, exercise sound judgment, assess organizational risk, and develop practical, compliant solutions in a dynamic business environment.

  

**Computer Skills:**

  

Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and experience with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), document management systems, learning management systems, audit management tools, and computerized system validation principles. Ability to quickly learn new software applications.

  

**CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT**

  

Verification of educational requirements, employment history, professional references, and certifications/training and U.S. work authorization.

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL EFFORT**

  

  
* Work is primarily performed in a professional office environment and may be conducted onsite, remotely, or in a hybrid work arrangement based on business needs and management approval.
  
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support audits, regulatory inspections, client meetings, and business operations.
  

  

The above job description does not imply these outlined duties are the only duties performed by this employee. The incumbent is expected to perform other related duties necessary for the effective operation of the department and company.

  

ProSciento reserves the right to change or alter any of the above duties and responsibilities according to the operational needs of the department and company.

**Company Background and Summary**

Votaw Precision Technologies is a trusted leader in the manufacturing of complex precision components, assemblies, and systems for the aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors. With a strong reputation for technical excellence, quality craftsmanship, and on-time delivery, Votaw supports some of the world’s most demanding programs through its advanced manufacturing capabilities. The company specializes in precision machining, fabrication, welding, and complex assembly operations for mission-critical applications. Votaw Precision Technologies has long been a trusted partner in building mission-critical hardware for some of the most advanced aerospace and defense programs in the world. Our precision components support the International Space Station, nearly every major launch vehicle in operation, high-performance spacecraft (including classified missions), as well as next-generation fighter aircraft, bombers, submarines, radar systems, and ground vehicles.

We are seeking an experienced and highly knowledgeable Operations Director to lead the overall operations of a high-performance CNC machine shop. This individual will have full responsibility for the day-to-day management, technical excellence, production performance, staffing, scheduling, efficiency, and continuous improvement of the facility.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned machining professional with approximately 20 years of industry experience who understands metal cutting and CNC machining at a deep technical level and has progressed into a strong operational leadership role.

The Operations Director must be able to walk onto the shop floor, understand the machining challenges, evaluate processes, communicate effectively with machinists and programmers, identify inefficiencies, and make sound technical and operational decisions. The company utilizes a variety of CNC machining technologies, including 3-axis, 4-axis, and 5-axis machining, as well as vertical milling, welding and large-scale assembly tooling.

**Essential Functions**

* Responsible for ensuring that the entire organization operates safely, efficiently, profitably, and to the highest standards of quality and technical excellence.
* Have overall responsibility for the day-to-day operations of the CNC machine shop.
* Establish and maintain a culture of technical excellence, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Provide leadership and direction to machining, programming, production, quality, maintenance, and other shop personnel.
* Ensure the shop has the appropriate personnel, equipment, tooling, processes, and resources to meet customer requirements.
* Establish clear expectations for supervisors, leads, machinists, programmers, and support personnel.
* Serve as the primary operational leader and decision maker for the manufacturing facility.
* Work closely with programmers, machinists, and engineers to resolve technical machining issues.
* Evaluate machining processes and identify opportunities to improve cycle time, tool life, throughput, and quality.
* Ensure manufacturing processes are technically sound, repeatable, and scalable.
* Provide technical guidance when difficult or complex machining problems arise.
* Maintain an environment where machinists, engineers, programmers continuously improve their technical capabilities.
* Responsible for weld shop, tooling assembly, and manufacturing readiness team.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Approximately 20 years of experience in the CNC machining/manufacturing industry.
* Previous experience as a Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, Operations Manager, Plant Manager, Production Manager, or Director of Operations.
* Experience managing multiple shifts and 24/7 operations
* Knowledge of complex, tight-tolerance, or high-value machined components.
* Experience with 5-axis machining and advanced CNC manufacturing.
* Implementing Lean Manufacturing or continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of ERP/MRP and production scheduling systems.
* Managing capital equipment purchases and machine capacity planning.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, medical, automotive, or other high-precision manufacturing environments is a plus.

**Personal Attributes**

* Highly self-motivated and directed.
* Keen attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
* Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

**Work Conditions**

* Ability to work onsite, including hours outside of a normal working day, to meet critical deadlines.
* This position operates within a precision manufacturing environment supporting the production of mission-critical aerospace and defense components. Success requires a high sense of urgency, attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple departments to ensure uninterrupted manufacturing operations and customer delivery commitments.
* Ability to work safely in a manufacturing environment, including walking the production floor, climbing stairs or ladders, occasionally lifting up to 25 pounds, and wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).

**Additional Requirements**

* This position requires the use of information or access to hardware subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons as defined by ITAR.

***Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience.***

***Votaw Precision Technologies, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Disability/Vets.***

**Job Description**
**Director, Production Operations in Springfield, MO**
Build your future at Curia, where our work has the power to save lives
  
  
Curia is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) with over 30 years of experience partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to provide life-saving treatments to patients. At Curia, we are on a mission to advance our customers’ therapies from curiosity to cure and ultimately to improve patients’ lives.
  
  
We proudly offer
  
  

* Generous benefit options (eligible first day of employment)
* Paid training, vacation and holidays (vacation accrual begins on first day of employment)
* Career advancement opportunities
* Education reimbursement
* 401K program with matching contributions
* Learning platform
* And more!

At Curia, manufacturing excellence is at the heart of everything we do. The Director, Production Operations is a key member of the Springfield leadership team, responsible for managing, planning, directing, and coordinating manufacturing processes across our large scale, pilot plant, and technical services organizations. This leader ensures our operations are safe, compliant, cost-effective, and positioned for growth.
  
  
This is a role for a proven leader who brings both strategic vision and operational discipline. The Director contributes to the development of business and functional strategies, communicates them clearly across the site, and translates them into action. Working cross-functionally with Quality, Regulatory, and other departments, this leader drives high performance in cGMP compliance, schedule adherence, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
As much as this role is about operational outcomes, it is also about people. The Director identifies and develops the next generation of leaders within the organization, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration that reflects the Curia Way.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**
**Strategy and Planning**

* Develop and implement short and long range goals and objectives that align with business growth and profitability targets.
* Set strategic leadership goals for key section heads within the large scale, pilot plant, and technical services organizations.
* Review operational plans to assess manufacturing capacity requirements and make recommendations to improve capacity utilization and support business development planning.
* Develop, implement, and maintain Key Performance Indicators and monitoring systems to drive high levels of performance within the department and across the organization.

Operations and Compliance
  
  

* Oversee manufacturing operations to ensure safety, quality, productivity, and efficiency, working collaboratively with the management team to prevent and resolve operational, quality, financial, and facility issues.
* Partner with Quality and Regulatory departments to drive high performance in cGMP compliance and ensure operations meet organizational requirements for quality management, health and safety, legal, and environmental standards.
* Ensure proper planning and effective execution of production activities to minimize downtime and maximize output per the production schedule, working closely with supporting departments to maintain schedule adherence.
* Proactively lead local efforts to prepare for and execute productive customer visits.
* Analyze activities, costs, operations, and forecast data to assess progress toward goals and initiate corrective action as needed to meet business and financial objectives.
* Perform other related duties as may be reasonably assigned in the course of business.

**Good Manufacturing & Documentation Practices**
Quality is something we take pride in together. You’ll perform your work in alignment with cGMP requirements and Curia’s standards to ensure our facilities support the safe and reliable manufacture of products for our customers.
  
  

* Perform all documentation in compliance with ALCOA++ principles and site SOPs.
* Adhere to applicable cGMP documents including SOPs, batch records, protocols, change controls, and controlled forms.
* Keep all required cGMP training current and escalate quality concerns along with proposed solutions to the Quality department.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
* Minimum 5–10 years of mid to senior management experience in a manufacturing or process environment
* Demonstrated understanding of the responsibilities and functions of key departments within a pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturing facility
* Strong knowledge of cGMP compliance, technical operations, and quality systems within a manufacturing environment
* Proven ability to identify, develop, and inspire leaders at multiple levels of the organization
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present strategy and performance clearly to site and functional leadership

**Preferred**

* Experience with API development and manufacturing processes
* Certification in Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma

**Physical Requirements**
The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.
  
  

* Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, talk, and hear.
* Frequently required to use hands to handle or feel objects, reach with hands and arms, and climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* May occasionally lift and/or move up to 55 pounds.
* Visual requirements include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**
The work environment characteristics described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this role.
  
  

* Regular work in a standard office environment, with frequent entry into the production area of a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility.
* Production environment may include moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles, extreme heat, wet or humid conditions, low levels of toxic or caustic chemicals, and outdoor weather conditions.
* Noise level in the work environment is typically moderate.

*New York, New York, United States (Hybrid – 3 days/week in office)*
Who We Are
  
  
At Pets + People, we make tails wag and customers smile with products brought to market through strategic licensing and innovation. Our brands make everyday life fresh, fun, and user-friendly for the whole family.
  
  
Our team of over 80 dedicated employees is headquartered in New York City with both national and global support. With our background, experience, and network, we are uniquely positioned to extend the reach of any brand to a new market.
  
  
“We’ve been a pioneer in licensing since 2008, translating favorite brands into practical ‘pet’ applications. In 2014, we expanded our vision into new markets within the ‘people’ sector. Now, we are leveraging our long track record of success and applying it both to pets + people.” – Steven Shweky, Top Dog
  
  
**About The Role**
Learn more about our capabilities at www.petspeople.com
  
  
We are seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking Director of Production to lead and evolve our global production organization within a fast-paced Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) environment. This role is critical in driving operational excellence across both domestic and international production, while also reimagining how production can be more innovative, automated, and scalable as the business grows.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who thrives in complexity, can manage a large SKU portfolio across multiple markets, builds strong global vendor partnerships, and inspires teams through coaching and mentorship. This person will lead on behalf of the department head when needed and serve as a strategic thought partner across the organization. We are open to candidates from a variety of industries, provided they bring transferable production leadership experience and a passion for continuous improvement.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Global Production Leadership & Strategy
  
  

* Lead end-to-end domestic and international production operations, with ownership of the full purchase order (PO) lifecycle from placement through manufacturing, delivery, and payment.
* Develop and execute production strategies that support growth, scalability, and on-time delivery across multiple regions and manufacturing partners.
* Act as a senior leader within the organization, representing the production function and driving alignment across cross-functional teams.
* Proactively manage capacity, timing, and execution risk across a high-volume, high-SKU environment.

Innovation & Automation
  
  

* Identify and implement process improvements, automation, and system enhancements to improve speed, visibility, and decision-making.
* Reduce manual work and streamline production workflows across teams and departments.
* Champion data-driven production management through clear metrics, dashboards, and reporting.

Vendor & External Partner Management
  
  

* Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with domestic and international manufacturing partners.
* Establish and manage supplier performance metrics, including on-time delivery, lead time reliability, and execution accuracy.
* Drive continuous improvement and cost optimization across the production lifecycle.
* Maintain disciplined execution and strong supplier performance management.
* Act as the primary escalation point for vendor execution, capacity, and delivery risks.

People Leadership & Development
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing production team, fostering a culture of accountability, growth, and engagement.
* Build clear organizational structure, roles, and communication rhythms to support scale.
* Develop future leaders through coaching, feedback, and development planning.

Operational Excellence & Scale
  
  

* Strengthen operational rigor through standardized workflows and clear cross-functional handoffs.
* Identify and proactively address risks related to capacity, cost, supply continuity, and execution across domestic and international production.
* Ensure production operations are scalable to support rapid growth and evolving business needs.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 10+ years of progressive experience in production, manufacturing, or operations leadership; CPG experience strongly preferred, but industry background is flexible.
* Proven success managing both domestic and international production operations.
* Experience managing and developing teams of 5–10; a hands-on people leader with a passion for coaching, mentoring, and team development within a lean, high-output team structure.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex production environments with large SKU counts.
* Track record of driving process improvement, innovation, and automation.
* Strong global vendor management and negotiation experience.
* Bilingual in Chinese and English preferred.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to execute at a detailed, operational level.
* Comfortable operating in an evolving environment.
* Strong proficiency in Excel; tech-savvy and resourceful, with a demonstrated ability to quickly adopt new systems, tools, and platforms as the business scales.

Hybrid Work
  
  
We're a hybrid office culture, in office 3 days per week with flexibility to work from home the rest. We value the connection and collaboration that in-person work brings, while giving our team room to work in the way that's most effective for them.

protected_roles.description:
****Panther: Better Health Is Skin Deep****
Panther is building the leading skin-powered treatment delivery and data platform for health and longevity. Its proprietary intradermal SmartPatch™ precisely delivers treatments to activate local and systemic healing, unlocking the skin as a scalable gateway for care. Panther’s AI-based platform accelerates partners’ product development and personalizes treatment, resulting in compelling consumer and provider experiences. Panther is targeting economically attractive markets of increasing clinical and regulatory difficulty, starting with its PIQUE™ branded Skincare products in mid-2027, and rapidly progressing to Medical Aesthetics and Therapeutics thereafter. Panther’s platform, significant IP portfolio and staged regulatory strategy provide a defensible moat. Panther is led by a team of successful entrepreneurs and operators and is advised by leading scientific experts.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Panther Life Sciences is building a new category of consumer-centric health and beauty products powered by our SmartPatch platform. As we move from development into commercialization, manufacturing becomes the critical unlock for scale, quality, and customer trust.
  
  
We are seeking a Director of Manufacturing Operations to own this transition end-to-end. This role is responsible for translating innovative R&D into reliable, high-quality, and scalable commercial production across both cosmetic and medical device products. You will lead the build-out of Panther's manufacturing strategy, serving as the bridge between internal development teams and external CMO partners.
  
  
You will define how manufacturing operates at Panther, from selecting and standing up partners, to leading technology transfer, to building the systems that allow us to scale from thousands to millions of units. This is not a maintenance role. You will be building the manufacturing function from scratch. Your work will directly impact product availability, customer experience, and the company's ability to grow.
  
  
You will work closely with the leadership team and cross-functional team members in formulation, device development, and quality to establish a manufacturing engine that supports both near-term commercial goals and long-term platform expansion. This is for someone who wants to build, scale, and set the standard for manufacturing in a category-defining company with a great team and a platform that is already generating clinical results. If you want to build something that matters, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Some travel will required approximately 10% -30%
  
  
This role is ideally based in Pittsburgh, with New York as an alternative location."
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**CDMO & Manufacturing Operations**

* Serve as the primary relationship owner and day-to-day point of contact for CMO partners
* Lead technology transfer from R&D to clinical and commercial manufacturing
* Oversee late-stage clinical and commercial production across product lines
* Drive manufacturing performance metrics including yield, throughput, and product quality
* Support CMO selection and onboarding, including process validation and scale-up
* Build and manage supply chain, logistics, fulfillment, and inventory operations
* Own material sourcing and supplier relationships
* Identify critical dependencies and build supplier redundancy to mitigate risk

**Scaling, Systems & Financial Planning**

* Build the manufacturing line from the ground up with a path from ~10K to ~1M units per month
* Drive automation, process optimization, and line redesign as production scales
* Own manufacturing cost modeling and financial planning (FP&A) for operations
* Develop sourcing strategy and budget frameworks in partnership with finance and leadership
* Establish systems and processes to support future team growth and internal manufacturing capabilities

**Quality, Compliance & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Ensure manufacturing quality, regulatory compliance, and adherence to QMS
* Partner cross-functionally with leadership, formulation, device, and quality teams
* Contribute to customer satisfaction through reliable product delivery and issue resolution

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience scaling a product from R&D to commercial manufacturing in a regulated environment
* Experience overseeing manufacturing operations for a Class II or III medical device or equivalent regulated product
* Hands-on experience scaling production volumes significantly (e.g., 10x or more)
* Direct experience working with CMO partners including selection, onboarding, and tech transfer
* Experience managing supply chain, logistics, inventory, and fulfillment operations
* Familiarity with Quality Management Systems (QMS) in regulated environments
* Demonstrated ability to lead technology transfer and process scale-up
* Experience with manufacturing cost modeling and financial planning
* Direct people management experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with combination products (drug + device), such as auto-injectors, EpiPens, nasal sprays, or microarray-based systems
* Background in Material Science & Technology Transfer (MSNT)
* Experience scaling production to high-volume output (100K+ units per month)
* Experience across both cosmetic and medical device products
* Experience with automation and line redesign in a manufacturing scale-up context
* Background in customer support or customer-facing operations within manufacturing
* Experience managing managers or building multi-layered organizations
* Strong systems orientation with experience implementing or optimizing operational infrastructure

**Benefits**

* Build something unique and high-impact with a world-class team of experts in technology, healthcare, and science.
* Equity in the form of stock options
* Competitive health insurance, including 90% employer-paid medical, plus dental and vision
* Life, AD&D and short-term disability insurance
* Paid time off and paid company holidays
* In-person company events
* Fully stocked kitchen

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Panther Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, citizenship, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Company Information**
*At Richelieu Foods, we are dedicated to a culture of belonging for everyone. Driven by our values of ownership, respect, and growth, we put people, safety, and quality above all else -- delicious pizza, outstanding service, and solid customer relationships are what happens as a result.*
*Richelieu Foods, Inc. is a leading national private label and contract packing food manufacturer focused on frozen pizza. We have two manufacturing facilities located in IL and WI. We provide products to many national retailers, wholesalers, distributors, club and mass stores, as well as industrial accounts including other food manufacturers.*
**Job Summary**
At Richelieu Foods we are making Great Food from Great People. We are looking for an experienced Director of Plant Operations who is comfortable driving transformation while reinforcing a culture of support and development. The Director of Plant Operations will report directly to the Senior Director of Operations with significant exposure to the Richelieu Senior Leadership Team. The Director of Plant Operations will lead the manufacturing operations for the facility, producing quality products in a people and food-safe manner, at or below budgeted cost. The position will be responsible for ensuring plant operations follow all regulatory, quality and safety standards. This role will be responsible for driving continuous improvement initiatives, striving to deliver zero loss and 100% employee engagement in support of Richelieu’s integrated manufacturing strategy.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Create a high-performance operations team by recruiting and developing teams with an appropriate mix of experience, capabilities, and skills to consistently meet company goals and departmental initiatives in the most cost-effective manner. Ensure effective succession planning for all pivotal positions.
* Create and efficiently manage four key divisions of operations: 1) Manufacturing 2) Maintenance 3) Materials and 4) Operational excellence. Understand the financial impacts of various sourcing, labor, materials and overhead strategies on the business and act accordingly to maximize returns.
* Support new projects for the business, engaging suppliers to help the team understand any costs and design implication. Ability to engage and collaborate cross-functionally to facilitate commercialization of new products and partnering closely with the leadership team to support the broader activities and initiatives.
* Manage KPI's to include (but not limited to): Safety, Quality, People, Service, and Cost
* Manage technology and process improvement projects to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the operations function.
* Plan, organize and direct the manufacturing operations ensuring the plant meets the daily production schedule, producing products that meet or exceed established standards.
* Establish and communicate clear metric targets and results. Develop and execute plans that drive improved operational performance.
* Participate in the development, implementation & evaluation of business goals that deliver strategic business objectives.
* Develop and execute job training programs that build the capability of the factory and leadership team members, including skill-based pay for the factory team and succession planning for the leadership team.
* Teach and deploy lean six-sigma tools such as daily direction setting, 5S, equipment center lining, defect handling and root cause failure analysis that drive towards zero loss and 100% employee engagement.
* Manage budget and cost controls considering changes in demand (volume), business seasonality and required service levels.
* Identify manufacturing cost drivers and proactively adjust manpower and department expenses to achieve budget commitments.
* Daily focus on yields with a particular focus on raw and pack materials. Actively participate in the KPI calls to report on results and improvement plans.
* Ensure the plant meets OSHA requirements and continually improve safety record by addressing both physical safety issues as well as employee safety attitudes. Cultivate a safety culture. Ensure compliance with all food regulatory requirements and adherence to food safety and GMP's.
* Maintain superior scores on all SQF or other third-party audits (customer driven).
* Ensure all products meet product specifications and consumer / customer complaints are fully investigated and addressed.
* Participate in the development of the strategic plan for the factory including the development of the annual operating budget and quarterly forecasts.
* Inspire the team and be the voice of the company’s core values, to motivate and capture personal commitment in creating a pathway to both their individual and our collective long-term success and growth.
* Develop a strong discipline of role clarity and hold self and team members accountable for performance and collaboration with the whole enterprise establishing and maintaining an inclusive and diverse culture that provides a positive employee experience and ensuring proactive performance management based on feedback, coaching and mentoring.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive operations experience in a high volume, high growth, food manufacturing environment
* 5+ years of management experience
* Formal training in all aspects of SQF, Food Safety & Quality, FDA’s FSMA program, including Food Safety, Good Manufacturing Practices, Food Plant Sanitation, FDA Regulations and AIB.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* USDA Experience preferred.

**Essential Skills And Abilities**

* Superior analytical skills to anticipate manufacturing requirements and develop contingency plans that eliminate or reduce disruption to operations.
* Strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to deliver to deadlines with strong follow-up skills, problem resolution, and strategic thinking.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills (written and verbal) and the ability to interact with all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated leadership ability with highly effective interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to resolve conflicting interests and obtain cooperation.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to respond to changing situations despite deadlines and pressure.
* Strong Food and Safety knowledge including legal compliance of federal, state and local food and safety laws and regulations.
* Excellent Team-building skills and possess the ability to gain consensus and deliver results with and through people.
* Ability to provide clear direction.

**Working Conditions**

* On-Site: This role requires 100% onsite attendance to perform the essential functions of the role

**Pay And Benefits**
The following information is provided in accordance with applicable state and local laws. Compensation is based on experience, geographic locations, and other legally permitted factors. The expected compensation range for this role is $170,000 and $200,000. This role is also eligible for an annual incentive plan bonus.
  
  
Benefits for this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance; pre-tax spending accounts; 401K with company match; paid time off; short-term and long-term disability; and life insurance.
  
  
**Disclosures**
This job description is not intended, nor should it be construed to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, or working conditions associated with the job. It is intended only to be a general description of the essential functions common to positions of this type.
